errors.evidence: The bars are not ordered alphabetically by country name. They are ordered in ascending order of their total height (the sum of the values for all years).

The chart uses stacked bars, where segments for different years are placed on top of each other within a single bar. It does not use grouped bars, where bars for different years would be placed side-by-side.

errors.text_span: България има най-висока стойност за 2020 година
errors.evidence: Bulgaria has the highest total bar, meaning the highest aggregate value across all five years. The description incorrectly states it has the highest value specifically for the year 2020. The yellow segment (2020) for Bulgaria is not the largest single segment on the chart.

errors.text_span: а останалите държави имат последователно увеличаващи се стойности за всяка година
errors.evidence: This claims that for every country, the values increase from 2016 to 2017 to 2018, etc. This is not true. For many countries, the values for individual years (the heights of the colored segments) fluctuate without a consistent increasing trend.
